headline: The arm delivered the vitamin bottle, not the pill bottle: perception chose a look-alike by a 0.07 confidence margin.

claims.text: The tray holds vitamin_bottle; the pill bottle is not in it.
The object in the fingers at 5.48 s was the vitamin bottle (0.95 at close range), not the pill bottle.
Perception picked obj2 as the pill bottle with 0.52 against 0.46 for vitamin bottle, a 0.07 margin. Up close the same track read vitamin bottle at 0.95.
The run ran out of time. Refuted: the run ended at 16.72 s, inside its 25 s deadline.
The arm hit something. Refuted: no joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.
The object slipped out of the gripper. Refuted: the gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 5.48 s until it was told to open at 11.72 s.
The gripper closed on nothing. Refuted: every grasp stopped on an object.
The target was not on the bench. Refuted: the pill bottle was on the bench the whole time (obj9), untouched.
The controller was told to fetch a different object. Refuted: perception searched for 'pill_bottle', exactly the goal's target.
Refuse to grasp when the top two labels are within 0.15; take a close-range look first.

hypotheses.test: Where the camera last saw every object labelled as the target, and whether that is inside the destination zone.
hypotheses.refute_if: No object labelled as the target is inside the destination zone in the last camera frame.
hypotheses.summary: The tray holds vitamin_bottle; the pill bottle is not in it.
hypotheses.why: decides whether there is a failure to explain

hypotheses.statement: The run ran out of time.
hypotheses.test: Whether the controller hit the goal's deadline before finishing.
hypotheses.refute_if: The run ended before the deadline with no deadline event.
hypotheses.summary: The run ended at 16.72 s, inside its 25 s deadline.

hypotheses.test: Whether a joint stalled (measured speed near zero) while its command kept moving, building tracking error, and whether its motor current rose with it. Lag at high speed builds error too, but the joint keeps moving.
hypotheses.refute_if: No joint stalls with more than 2.5 deg of tracking error while its command is moving.
hypotheses.summary: No joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.

hypotheses.statement: The object slipped out of the gripper.
hypotheses.test: After the grasp, whether the fingers (still commanded closed) closed past the object, and whether the object's camera track fell away from the fingertip.
hypotheses.refute_if: The gripper opening stays at the object's width from the grasp until the gripper is commanded open.
hypotheses.summary: The gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 5.48 s until it was told to open at 11.72 s.

hypotheses.statement: The arm moved a different object than the goal named.
hypotheses.test: Which camera track was in the fingers at the grasp, and what perception called it at close range.
hypotheses.refute_if: The grasped track's confident label is the goal's target.
hypotheses.summary: The object in the fingers at 5.48 s was the vitamin bottle (0.95 at close range), not the pill bottle.

runs.summary: The grasped object is the pill bottle (0.96), the goal's target.

hypotheses.test: Whether a grasp closed the fingers fully (below 3 deg) right after reaching for the object.
hypotheses.refute_if: Every grasp stopped on an object (opening above 3 deg).
hypotheses.summary: Every grasp stopped on an object.

hypotheses.statement: Perception mistook a look-alike for the target.
hypotheses.test: At the moment perception chose the object, how far its label confidence was from the runner-up, and what the same track read as up close.
hypotheses.refute_if: The choice had a clear margin (>= 0.15), or the close-range label agrees with the target.
hypotheses.summary: Perception picked obj2 as the pill bottle with 0.52 against 0.46 for vitamin bottle, a 0.07 margin. Up close the same track read vitamin bottle at 0.95.

runs.summary: Perception's choice had a 0.88 margin and the close-range label is pill_bottle.

hypotheses.statement: The target was not on the bench.
hypotheses.test: Whether any other camera track carries the target's label.
hypotheses.refute_if: Some other track is labelled as the target.
hypotheses.summary: The pill bottle was on the bench the whole time (obj9), untouched.

hypotheses.statement: The controller was told to fetch a different object.
hypotheses.test: The label perception searched for, against the goal's target.
hypotheses.refute_if: Perception searched for the goal's target.
hypotheses.summary: Perception searched for 'pill_bottle', exactly the goal's target.
